correctness.rationale: The source double series has a positive inner m-sum multiplied by a common alternating n-sign. Its m=0 contribution therefore lower-bounds the magnitude of each outer block. The exact gamma-ratio asymptotic makes those blocks fail the term test for every 0<k<1 and for k=1 when 2r lambda>=1. The true moments remain finite on bounded support. The k=lambda=r=1 counterexample and Tonelli-valid replacement were independently replayed in the packaged checker.

originality.rationale: The primary paper states Eq. (3.8) without a convergence restriction and reuses the same integrated coefficients in its MGF series. Five focused published-result searches, exact DOI/correction searches, and comparison with the related unit arcsine-exponential special case found no published UASWD correction. The owned same-source result concerns Rényi-integral existence rather than moment-series convergence, while a separate owned FEPW finding concerns a different distribution and formula.

value.rationale: Moments and the MGF are presented as central statistical properties and as tools for deriving mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis, and further inference. The printed moment representation fails throughout the whole 0<k<1 region and at additional k=1 points, while the paper's own fitted model has k=0.9952. The correction therefore affects the advertised analytic tractability at the empirical fit, not merely an unused boundary case, and supplies a globally valid positive replacement.
